name: tamirs-superpowers
description: 29 bundled skills, 10 specialist agents, smart worktree hooks, statusline, and MCP server stubs — plan, implement, review, debug, multi-agent setup, and audit code from one plugin.

pushover_token.title: Pushover application token
pushover_token.description: Optional. From your Pushover application at pushover.net/apps. Leave blank to keep phone notifications off - the notification hook stays silent when unconfigured.

pushover_user.title: Pushover user key
pushover_user.description: Optional. Your Pushover user key from pushover.net. Required only if you set an application token above.

rate_limit_warn_percent.title: Rate-limit warning threshold (%)
rate_limit_warn_percent.description: The mod shows a band above the prompt with a one-press handoff once any rate-limit window (5h, 7d, spend) reaches this percentage. Claude Code and Claude Desktop only.

pushover_min_turn_seconds.title: Pushover: notify after turns longer than (seconds)
pushover_min_turn_seconds.description: With pushover_token and pushover_user set, the mod sends a Pushover message when a main-session turn longer than this finishes or dies on an API error. 0 notifies on every turn. Claude Code and Claude Desktop only.

semantic_skill_suggest.title: Semantic skill suggestions (one small-model call per long prompt)
semantic_skill_suggest.description: Off by default. When on, prompts of 12+ words are classified by a small model against the bundled skill names and a matching skill is named to Claude as context. hooks/skill-suggest.sh's keyword matching stays on either way.
